Curzon Cinema Private Hire

Curzon Cinemas have the technical knowhow, attention to detail and experience to turn your initial brief into a successful event. Our cinemas are suitable for a number of hires such as:

  • Film Screenings
  • Corporate Presentations
  • Corporate Hospitality
  • Product Launches
  • AGMs
  • Networking Events
  • Cast & Crew Screenings
  • Premieres
  • Film Festivals
  • Student Showreel Presentations
  • Private Parties

We can accommodate groups from 28 up to 307 in screen. All our cinemas have a unique identity ensuring we deliver bespoke events that match your requirements. We provide top quality technical facilities in comfortable screens that can cater to everything from film screenings to corporate presentations.

We have a dedicated events team to look after your needs who will welcome you for a site visit to discuss your requirements, guide you through various options for the structure of your event and ensure the smooth running of proceedings. Our friendly and knowledgeable technical staff will ensure any event, from presentation to screening, is executed to the highest standard, and we offer the option to work with external AV providers if needed.

In addition to our screens we provide spacious attractive bar areas with a full food and beverage offer to complement the event. Each of our venues has a fully licensed bar and drinks can be taken into all of the screens.  We have a wide in-house offering, from morning coffee and pastries to full receptions, and also work with caterers to add to your event should you require this.

Curzon is known as a place to discover other worlds and cultures, or see a different perspective. We already have the large screen, projector and comfortable seats - you just have to decide the content and bring your imagination.

Interested in hosting your next party at Curzon?  For children's parties, gaming, hen/stag parties or simply a group get-together, Book The Cinema offers a quick and easy way to book a screening in our venues.

If you are looking to watch a newly released film, or your preferred choice isn’t available on Book The Cinema, please reach out directly via our enquiry form and we will be happy to assist.

Enquiry Form

Please complete the below form with your event enquiry details.

You can also email us your enquiry at [email protected] or call on 0207 953 2172. If you do send us an email please provide full details of your event requirements.

## About Curzon Victoria

Curzon Victoria is a **Trusted Tagvenue Partner**, validated by the Tagvenue team with a record of successful bookings on the platform.

Curzon Victoria is a boutique cinema with a glass-fronted entrance and a multi-level interior organised across several floors.  

**Venue highlights:** All screens are fitted with reclining seats and small tables. A ground-floor café is lined with velvet sofas and a mezzanine level contains a bar. Food and drink service is available throughout the venue.  

**Best for:** Film screenings, hospitality-led premieres and location filming that require an interior cinema setting.  

**Location:** Victoria is the neighbourhood. Paid off‑site parking is available and the building includes a lift serving all floors to assist load‑in.  

**What guests say:** The staff are friendly and helpful. The venue maintains clean screening areas and toilets.

## FAQ

Can cocktails and other specialist drinks be arranged?

Yes, cocktails, G&T and hard seltzer cans can be arranged through an agreed pre-order. Orders are needed two weeks ahead to secure staffing and stock, and orders made after this cannot be guaranteed.

How are accessibility requirements handled?

Please communicate any specific accessibility requirements as soon as possible so the venue can ensure it is able to accommodate them.

Can the venue provide tea and coffee receptions?

Yes, the venue can provide tea and coffee receptions, breakfast items, lunch platters and salads, and hot food options.

Does lunch have to be served in the mezzanine?

No. Food can be laid out for self-service in the screen or outside the screen at no additional cost, allowing guests to take it inside.

What is the cancellation and refund policy at Curzon Victoria?

Cancellations **60 days in advance** will receive a full refund.

Cancellations **60 days to 30 days in advance** will receive a 50% refund.

Cancellations **for events starting within 30 days** are non-refundable.
